name: MAXHUB 白板书写

description: MAXHUB白板书写软件主要用于企业会议、课堂教学中的书写批注、多人协作和内容保存分享，支持双指手势、智能图形识别、OCR、插入多媒体等功能，轻量而又强大。
descriptionEn: MAXHUB Whiteboard is used for writing and annotation in meetings and classrooms, multi-user collaboration, and saving or sharing content. It supports two-finger gestures, shape recognition, OCR and multimedia insertion, and is both lightweight and capable.
